section_summary.extract_value: This Limitations and Future Directions section notes that the study used cross-sectional, correlational data and therefore cannot determine causality; the authors call for prospective longitudinal studies to address this. It also states the sample tended to consist primarily of healthy, well-educated, Caucasian women, limiting generalizability and prompting recommendations to include women from the LGBTQ community, diverse cultural backgrounds, and clinical samples in future research. The section highlights cohort effects and potential fluctuations over time as additional concerns for future longitudinal work.
